course.title: Applied Statistics and Queuing Theory
course.department: Department of Computer Science and Engineering

content.value: Before the distribution of certain statistical software, every fourth compact disk (CD) is tested for (08) accuracy. The testing process consists of running four independent programs and checking the results. The failure rates for the four testing programs are, respectively 0·01, 0·03, 0·02, 0·01.
i) What is the probability that a CD was tested and failed any test?
ii) Given that a CD was tested, what is the probability that it failed program 2 or 3?
